items.description: Gold-rimmed in-game coin. Obverse: embossed gold phoenix on black disc with magenta tech ring. Reverse: magenta figure-8 over gold galaxy spiral. Rim text (as printed): 'PHOENIX GOD, ANTERRANIAN MONACH' (sic MONARCH), 'DIVINE RIGHT', 'UNIVERSAL WEALTH'.

printed_text.note: Art prints MONACH (missing R); canonical title spelling is MONARCH. Same title family as batch_22 MONORCH typo.
